scheme_name: The Inland Waterways Authority of India Internship Scheme
other_conditions: Candidate must be pursuing or have completed a Graduate or Post Graduate degree from a recognized university (national or international).
Graduates must have at least 75% marks in the 12th standard.
Post Graduate students must have obtained at least 60% marks in their graduation.
Research scholars must have scored at least 60% marks in their Post Graduate degree.
Interns must have their own laptops.
Interns must furnish a declaration of secrecy before reporting for the internship.
Interns are required to submit a report/paper on the allotted subject at the end of the internship.
Applicants must fill the application forms as prescribed in Annexure-A and enclose their CVs.
Applications must be sent to the Secretary, IWAI, A-13, Sector-1, Noida-201301, clearly indicating the area of interest.
benefits_summary: Stipend of ₹10,000 per month for undergraduates and ₹20,000 per month for postgraduate/research scholars, along with an experience certificate upon successful completion.
